backup.sync.failed: Sync could not finish. Your local data is kept. Check your cloud connection and try again.
backup.sync.conflictsFooter: Two devices edited these offline. Pick the version to keep.
backup.sync.chooseMessage: Use “{{summary}}” for this item on your devices? This resolves its saved conflict.
backup.title: Backup
backup.section.icloudInfo: Backs up automatically when your data changes. Devices with the same recovery phrase stay in sync while the app is open.
backup.history.title: History
backup.status.unavailableFooter: Sign in to iCloud in Settings to sync across devices. Local backups still work.
backup.skipped.empty: There's nothing to back up yet. Add a card or a contact first.
backup.skipped.rootKeyUnavailable: Set up your recovery phrase before backing up, so the backup can be restored on any device.
backup.skipped.unknown: Couldn't back up right now. Nothing was changed — try again in a moment.
backup.restore.downloadFailed: iCloud couldn't download this backup. Check your connection and try again.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.aboutBody: Every passkey that can open your page on creds.id — added from this phone, another phone, or a browser. Removing one here stops it from signing in.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to edit your page on any computer.
passkeys.addFailed: Couldn't finish adding the passkey. Try again.
passkeys.alreadyRegistered: Already added with this provider. Choose another.
passkeys.renameFailed: Couldn’t rename this passkey. Please try again.
passkeys.removeBody: It will no longer sign in to your page on creds.id.
passkeys.removeLastBody: This is your last passkey. After removing it, only this app or your recovery phrase can open your page.
passkeys.removeHint: Removing stops this passkey from signing in. You can also delete it from your password manager.
passkeys.removeFailed: Couldn’t remove this passkey. Please try again.
webEditing.title: Edit on your computer
webEditing.connectBody: Add a passkey above to edit on your computer.
webEditing.connectedBody: On your computer, visit creds.id/edit and sign in with the same Passkey.
webEditing.checkFailed: Couldn't check the connection. Try again.
webEditing.openFailed: Couldn't open the browser. Try again.
webEditing.addressCopyFailed: Couldn't copy the address. Try again.
zktls.instructions: Paste your page link into your {{platform}} bio and save. We check the public profile — no login, no password.
zktls.instructionsX: Paste your page link into your X bio or the Website field and save. We check the public profile — no login, no password.
zktls.instructionsWebsite: Add a link to your page anywhere on your homepage and publish it. We check the public homepage.
zktls.keepMarker: Keep it there: we recheck every 30 days so the check stays current.
zktls.waiting: Paste it into your {{platform}} bio, save, then come back here — we’ll check automatically.
zktls.waitingX: Paste it into your X bio or Website field, save, then come back here — we’ll check automatically.
zktls.provingPrivacy: Your phone opens the public page itself and signs the result with its hardware key — no creds.id server in between.
zktls.provingRetry: Not there yet. Platforms can take a few seconds to show a saved bio.
zktls.foundDetail: Add the check to your Page. Anyone can check it again on their own phone.
zktls.done: Verified. The check is on your page.
zktls.publishPending: Saved on this phone; publishing didn’t reach enough relays yet. It will go out with your next update.
zktls.renewFailed: A verified link couldn’t be rechecked. Open your page to see which one.
zktls.error.noNostrKey: Set up publishing first — the check is signed with your publishing key.
zktls.error.notFound: {{platform}} says this account doesn’t exist. Check the link on your page.
zktls.error.blocked: {{platform}} blocked the check this time. Try again later.
zktls.error.markerMissing: Your link isn’t in the bio yet. Make sure it’s saved, then try again.
zktls.error.failed: The check didn’t complete. Try again.
zktls.error.signDenied: The page wasn’t signed, so nothing changed. Try again when you’re ready.
zktls.error.noName: Claim your creds.id name first — your bio links to it.
zktls.error.unsupported: This phone has no hardware attestation (a simulator or an older Android), so it can't sign a check.
zktls.error.serverUnavailable: Apple's attestation service didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
zktls.error.deviceRejected: This phone's hardware attestation didn't pass (a development build, an unlocked bootloader, or a jailbreak).
zktls.error.network: Couldn't reach {{platform}}. Check your connection and try again.
witness.missing: Link not found on the profile
witness.publicNote: A witness is public: it says you checked this person's link with your phone.
witness.noName: This Page has no creds.id name that points back to it, so its links can't be checked.
deeplink.groupsRetired: Groups are no longer available in creds.id.

present.mode.offlineOnlyHint: Your Page is not published yet, so only the offline card is available.

credentialDetail.passportNotPresentable: Passports show on your Page as a badge, not from here.
credentialDetail.passportRescan: This passport was saved by an older check that did not confirm the issuing country. Scan your passport again to get a current badge.
